meta.description: IQ2GQ Hub - matched syndicate EPL/English football picks against real-world match results and bookmaker odds
meta.source_odds_data: football-data.co.uk. Premier League (E0) season files 2009/10-2026/27, plus Championship (E1) season files 2017/18-2026/27.
meta.source_syndicate_data: Raw_History tab, IQ2GQ 27 MM Database. IMPORTANT: syndicate English football picks are recorded under FOUR different Sport tag values that evolved over time - 'Football (England Domestic)' (2012-2019), 'Football (English Domestic)' (brief 2019-2020 variant), 'Football (EPL)' (2020-present), and 'Football (English Championship)' (2020-present). All four are combined here. An earlier version of this file only used the first tag and silently missed 288 rows (over half the true total) - if rebuilding this file from scratch, check for Sport tag variants FIRST, the same way sport-mistagging is checked for every other sport in this pipeline.
meta.matching_method: Team name canonicalisation (Man City/United, West Ham, Wolves incl. 'Wolverhamption Wolves' and 'Wimbeldon Wolves' typos, Stoke, Derby, Bournemouth, Blackburn, Huddersfield, Leicester, Nott'm Forest, Tottenham, West Brom, Bristol City, Peterboro) + nearest-date match within +/-10 days of the recorded pick date, searched across combined Premier League + Championship data. 'division' field on each record (E0/E1) shows which tier the matched game was actually played in.
meta.scope_note: Championship coverage currently only goes back to 2017/18. 6 rows remain unmatched because the pick predates that (2014/15-2016/17 seasons): Norwich x2, Portsmouth, Newcastle x2, Cambridge, Millwall.
meta.excluded_rows_note: 2 rows excluded for Sport field mistagging (Bayern Munich, Real Madrid). 4 rows excluded as genuinely out of scope: Notts County (League Two in 2018), Milton Keynes Dons (League One in 2019), Alvechurch F.C (non-league club, several tiers below Championship), and one unclear club name ('Brentworth').
meta.draw_handling_note: For H2H bet validation, a drawn match correctly counts as a loss (consistent with standard match-odds betting), not an automatic discrepancy.
